pages.text: $(thing)Paper$() is either made from the processed stalk of the $(l:mechanics/crops#papyrus)Papyrus$() crop, from $(l:mechanics/papermaking#parchment)Animal Hides$(), or $(l:mechanics/papermaking#paperfromwood)from a lengthy process using specific types of Wood$(). Paper is useful for written materials like $(thing)Books$() and $(thing)Maps$().
Papyrus must first be cut into strips with a $(thing)Knife$()
Then, papyrus strips are soaked in a $(l:mechanics/barrels)Barrel$() of $(thing)Water$().

Then, soaked papyrus strips are woven together in a loom to make $(thing)Unrefined Paper$(). Finally, it must be placed on a log and $(l:mechanics/leather_making#scraping)Scraped$() to make $(thing)Paper$().
Flip to the next page for information on papermaking via the parchment process.

$(thing)Parchment Paper$() starts with a scraped hide. Review the $(l:mechanics/leather_making)leather making chapter$() to learn how to make it. Parchment requires treatment with a few different items. First, $(thing)Pumice$() is needed. Pumice is found on the ground near $(l:the_world/geology)Volcanoes$(), or from $(l:mechanics/sluices)Sluicing$() or $(l:mechanics/panning)Panning$() ore deposits with Andesite, Rhyolite, or Dacite in them.
pages.title: Parchment

pages.name: Pumice
pages.text: A Pumice rock placed on the ground.
Crafting pumice, a hammer, and scraped hide gives sections of $(thing)Treated Hide$().
Treated hide, $(l:mechanics/glassworking#lime)lime powder$(), flour, and a fresh egg will complete the treatment process and yield usable paper.

$(thing)Creating Paper from Wood$() is an ancient process that requires processing of sturdy types of wood into sheets, which are broken down into a pulp, and then pressed, dried and scraped to make paper.$(br2)Note that softer types of wood are not suitable for making paper
pages.title: Paper from Wood

pages.text: Primeiro você precisa encontrar alguma Madeira Densa:$(br2)Acácia$(br)Álamo$(br)Bétula$(br)Bordo$(br)Carvalho$(br)Castanheira$(br)Ébano$(br)Freixo$(br)Jacarandá$(br)Nogueira$(br)Sicômoro

pages.title: Madeira Densa Descascada
pages.text: O processo começa removendo a casca de uma $(thing)Madeira Densa$() para expor as fibras internas da mesma. Você pode descascar colocando-a no chão e clicando nela com botão direito segurando um machado.

pages.title: Tira de Madeira Densa
pages.text: Em seguida, a madeira descascada é desbastada com um machado para obter $(item)Tiras de Madeira Densa$(). Isso pode ser feito usando um Machado ou métodos mais sofisticados

pages.title: Tira de Madeira Densa Encharcada
pages.text: Then, the individual strips are soaked in a $(l:mechanics/barrels)Barrel$() of $(thing)Water$(). This $(thing)debilitates the structural integrity$() of the $(thing)wood$() so it can be $(thing)broken down further$()

pages.title: Polpa de Madeira Densa
pages.text: Depois, utilize a $(l:mechanics/quern)Moenda$() para transformar as tiras encharcadas em $(item)Polpa de Madeira Densa$().

pages.title: Piling up the Pulp
pages.text: While the quern gives you small piles of pulp, you'll want to combine them together in a $(thing)Workbench$(). More sophisticated methods of crushing the strips yield higher amounts of pulp

pages.title: Breaking down the Pulp
pages.text: Before the pulp can be processed further into paper, it needs to be broken down further by $(thing)Boiling it with Lye$() in a $(l:firmalife/oven_appliances#vat)Vat$() or a $(l:mechanics/pot)Pot$().

pages.title: Pressing the Pulp
pages.text: Após ser decomposta por fervura com Lixívia, a $(item)Polpa de Madeira Densa Termoquimicamente Tratada$() pode ser prensada em uma folha de $(item)Papel Não Refinado Encharcado$().
You can utilize an $(l:mechanics/anvils)Anvil$() to beat down the pulp into a sheet

pages.title: Stomping in Barrel
pages.text: Como alternativa, você pode pisotear a Polpa de Madeira Densa Termoquimicamente Tratada em um $(l:firmalife/wine)Lagar$().
The final step is $(l:firmalife/drying)Drying$() the $(item)Soaked Unrefined Paper$() into $(item)Unrefined Paper$(), Which then can be Scraped into $(item)Paper$() as shown before.

pages.title: Cutting Steps...?
pages.text: Advancing in the Tech-Tree will allow you to create paper from wood with less overall steps, check $(thing)EMI$() for the different approaches you can take for making paper with wood.
